# Briefing: As of 25 January 2027, how exposed are Midgard and Tolan to the end of the Orvan corridor agreement? Give a low and high range for wheat and maize imports.

Case `CASE-E5-20261025201346` | as of 2027-01-25 | runs: 2 | status: **COMPLETE**

## Executive summary

- Event: **CONFIRMED**, still in effect at the as-of date. Orvan grain corridor collapse is CONFIRMED and still in effect as of 2027-01-25: 4 independent Tier 1-2 outlet(s) (Cargo Weekly, Harbour Review, Raven Wire, Realm Trade Ministry) confirm it and no credible evidence stands against it.
- Midgard Maize: Odin's range **50.2-62.5%** fall in import value (Thor 50.2-62.5%, Loki 38.5-62.5%).
- Midgard Wheat: Odin's range **37.4-45.1%** fall in import value (Thor 39.4-45.3%, Loki 37.4-45.3%).
- Tolan Maize: evidence missing; no range is given.
- Tolan Wheat: Odin's range **28.3-40.2%** fall in import value (Thor 31.4-40.2%, Loki 28.3-40.2%).
- Findings: 9 established, 0 contested, 0 conceded, 0 rejected.

## Established findings

- **T2-01** (THOR, Inference) Midgard has lost 62.5% of its maize imports from Orvan (November, December vs a year earlier); over the full months after onset the loss is 50.2% of the total import basket and no substitute supply is on the record. A spot-price premium of 12% is separately observed. [ORV-0030#P4, 2027-01-21 09:35] [ORV-0030#P5, 2027-01-21 09:35] [ORV-0030#P6, 2027-01-21 09:35]  
  _Ruling: UPHELD. scripted ruling_
- **T2-02** (THOR, Inference) Midgard has lost 60.3% of its wheat imports from Orvan (September, October, November, December vs a year earlier); even after recorded substitutes from Vanir, at least 39.4% of the total import basket is gone. A spot-price premium of 12% is separately observed. [ORV-0009#P4, 2027-01-19 09:20] [ORV-0009#P5, 2027-01-19 09:20] [ORV-0009#P6, 2027-01-19 09:20]  
  _Ruling: UPHELD. Verified against its sources and never credibly countered._
- **T2-03** (THOR, Inference) Tolan has lost 60.3% of its wheat imports from Orvan (September, October, November, December vs a year earlier); even after recorded substitutes from Vanir, at least 31.4% of the total import basket is gone. A spot-price premium of 12% is separately observed. [ORV-0046#P4, 2027-01-20 10:05] [ORV-0046#P5, 2027-01-20 10:05] [ORV-0046#P6, 2027-01-20 10:05]  
  _Ruling: UPHELD. Verified against its sources and never credibly countered._
- **T2-04** (THOR, Sourced fact) Even so, the direction is clear: Orvan's share of Midgard's grain imports has fallen, while Vanir and rail deliveries have taken part of the gap. [ORV-0022#P5, 2027-01-12 07:55]  
  _Ruling: UPHELD. Verified against its sources and never credibly countered._
- **T2-05** (THOR, Sourced fact) Preliminary customs figures show Midgard's wheat and maize arrivals from Orvan well below the levels of a year earlier in December. [ORV-0022#P1, 2027-01-12 07:55]  
  _Ruling: UPHELD. Verified against its sources and never credibly countered._
- **L2-01** (LOKI, Inference) Midgard's maize import loss is 38.5-62.5% of the total import basket depending on the window; the worst month is not the trend. [ORV-0030#P4, 2027-01-21 09:35] [ORV-0030#P5, 2027-01-21 09:35] [ORV-0030#P6, 2027-01-21 09:35]  
  _Ruling: UPHELD. scripted ruling_
- **L2-02** (LOKI, Inference) Net of substitute supply from Vanir, Midgard lost only 37.4-45.3% of its total recorded wheat import basket, well below the 60.3% headline fall from Orvan. [ORV-0009#P4, 2027-01-19 09:20] [ORV-0009#P5, 2027-01-19 09:20] [ORV-0009#P6, 2027-01-19 09:20]  
  _Ruling: UPHELD. Verified against its sources and never credibly countered._
- **L2-03** (LOKI, Inference) Net of substitute supply from Vanir, Tolan lost only 28.3-40.2% of its total recorded wheat import basket, well below the 60.3% headline fall from Orvan. [ORV-0046#P4, 2027-01-20 10:05] [ORV-0046#P5, 2027-01-20 10:05] [ORV-0046#P6, 2027-01-20 10:05]  
  _Ruling: UPHELD. Verified against its sources and never credibly countered._
- **L2-04** (LOKI, Sourced fact) Preliminary customs figures show Midgard's wheat and maize arrivals from Orvan well below the levels of a year earlier in December. [ORV-0022#P1, 2027-01-12 07:55]  
  _Ruling: UPHELD. Verified against its sources and never credibly countered._

## Next-quarter outlook

If conditions at 2027-01-25 persist, next quarter's loss stays near the latest months (November-December 2026):
- Midgard Maize: about 50.2-62.5%.
- Midgard Wheat: about 37.4-45.1%.
- Tolan Wheat: about 28.3-40.2%.

Assumptions: no new agreement or reopening before the next quarter (none is reported as of the as-of date); substitute suppliers keep their latest volumes; no document after the as-of date is used.
